description.value: You're no longer affected by frightened 1 at all; only frightened 2 or higher affects you, and then at one less.

cinderfall.incomplete: Ignoring frightened 1 entirely and reducing frightened 2+ by one step has no engine hook: this is the same condition-severity-reduction absence as Steady Under Fire (see the real Vambrace of Gorum/Obrimar precedent) and additionally requires a step-threshold rule (ignore only the lowest value) that has no analog anywhere in pf2e.
